title: virola subsessilis
intro: Virola subsessilis, commonly known as the "Sacha inchi" or "Mountain inchi" tree, is a plant species native to the Amazon rainforest. The health benefits of Virola subsessilis include its use in traditional medicine to aid in digestive issues, as well as its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Bioactive constituents of Virola subsessilis include fatty acids, antioxidants, and other compounds that contribute to its potential medicinal properties.
